title: silene viscosa
intro: Silene viscosa, commonly known as sticky catchfly, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Caryophyllaceae family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can aid in wound healing and the treatment of various infections. The therapeutic actions of Silene viscosa include its antiseptic, astringent, and antihemorrhagic properties, making it useful for controlling bleeding and soothing irritated skin. The bioactive constituents of Silene viscosa include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its pharmacological activities.
